data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Test Approach
Given: a valid defense JSON record with story_branch_tip_sha and story_branch_base_sha fields provided, and DSO_SESSION_TICKET_ID set
When: defense_store_write is called with the record
Then: the written DEFENSE_RECORD comment includes story_branch_tip_sha and story_branch_base_sha fields verbatim

Given: a valid defense JSON record WITHOUT story_branch_tip_sha/story_branch_base_sha (legacy record)
When: defense_store_write is called with the legacy record
Then: write succeeds without error and no sha fields are injected

## Implementation Notes
Create tests/review/test-defense-store-sha-range.sh to cover:
1. defense_store_write embeds story_branch_tip_sha/story_branch_base_sha when present in input JSON
2. defense_store_write succeeds when sha fields are absent (legacy path, no sha injection)
3. The emitted DEFENSE_RECORD JSON contains the sha fields when provided (verify via TICKET_CMD stub)

Test stub pattern: inject TICKET_CMD=bash /dev/stdin <<'EOF' ... EOF to capture written comment text.
Use the existing test stub pattern from tests/review/test-defense-store-ticket-binding.sh.

Update .test-index with RED marker [test_defense_store_write_records_sha_fields] for
plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh before committing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/review/test-defense-store-sha-range.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/review/test-defense-store-sha-range.sh
- [ ] Test file contains test_defense_store_write_records_sha_fields function
  Verify: grep -q 'test_defense_store_write_records_sha_fields' tests/review/test-defense-store-sha-range.sh
- [ ] Tests exit 1 (RED) before implementation — they assert behavior that does not exist yet
  Verify: bash tests/review/test-defense-store-sha-range.sh; test $? -ne 0
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_defense_store_write_records_sha_fields] for review-defense-store.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_defense_store_write_records_sha_fields\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
